पौण्ड्र १

PAUṆḌRA I . One of the barbarous tribes of men who had originated from the tail of nandinī. (Śloka 37, Chapter 174, Ādi Parva).

पौण्ड्र २

PAUṆḌRA II . A resident of the state of pauṇḍra. This state was in existence during the mahābhārata period. The king of the state was also called pauṇḍra. pauṇḍra was present for the marriage of pāñcālī. (Chapter 186, Ādi Parva). Pauṇḍras were also present for the rāja- sūya conducted by dharmaputra. During the big battle the Pauṇḍras fought against the kauravas constructing a krauñcavyūha (a battle array in the shape of a stork). (Chapter 50, bhīṣma parva). kṛṣṇa and karṇa on two different occasions conquered this country. (śānti Parva, M.B.) The Pauṇḍras were Kṣatriyas once. But the brahmins cursed them and changed them into Śūdras. (Chapter 85, anuśāsana parva).

पौण्ड्र ३

PAUṆḌRA III . The conch of Bhīmasena. He blew his conch at the beginning of the mahābhārata battle and also at the time when duryodhana fell down dead. (Chapter 61, śalya Parva).

पौण्ड्रक १

PAUṆḌRAKA I . A son of nikumbha. When during the rāma-rāvaṇa battle nikumbha died, his son pauṇḍraka took up the fight against rāma and was killed. (ānanda rāmāyaṇa).

पौण्ड्रक २

PAUṆḌRAKA II . (Pauṇḍrakavāsudeva). A king of ancient kārūṣa. Once he sent a messenger to dvārakā and told kṛṣṇa thus: “Oh kṛṣṇa, I am the real vāsudeva. Therefore put down all your royal emblems and robes and come and worship at my feet.” As soon as kṛṣṇa heard it he got angry and moved to kārūṣa with a large army and killed Pauṇḍrakavāsudeva. 10th skandha, bhāgavata).

पौण्ड्रक ३

PAUṆḌRAKA III . The name of the buffalo which is the vehicle of yama (Chapter 9, vāmana Purāna).

पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक

PAUṆḌRAMĀTSYAKA . A kṣatriya king. He was the son born to the demon vīra of a woman named danāyus. (Śloka 43, Chapter 67, Ādi Parva).
